scope: Two preselected local numeric KEEL binary variants for a descriptive controlled SSHR pilot; not exact author-score reproduction.
source_fidelity: User-provided local archives and extracted files; author rows, folds, preprocessing and unlabelled-pool construction unverified.
duplicate_policy: Preserve every raw row. Group identical raw feature-coordinate vectors before outer splitting and label hiding; reject groups containing conflicting gold labels at experimental-design time.
selection_policy: Selected before any held-out score: numerical declarations, existing locally verified files, no missing or nonfinite values, sufficient minority rows for five outer folds and training-only label hiding.

datasets.feature_declarations: All input attributes are declared real in the original KEEL header.
All input attributes are declared real in the original KEEL header.
datasets.duplicate_label_audit: All 31 duplicate pairs have majority gold labels; no duplicate coordinate group has conflicting labels. This is experimental-design metadata only.
